controls.title: Right to Know — consumer requests for categories and specific pieces of personal information collected
controls.what_we_dont_prove: That the disclosed categories and specific pieces of personal information were complete or accurate. The chain attests the response; the contents are the business's responsibility.
controls.what_we_prove: Right-to-know requests received, acknowledged, and fulfilled (or denied) by the business are recorded in the chain with tamper-evident ordering and signed timestamps. The request log is the evidence of compliance with the 45-day response window.

controls.title: Right to Delete — consumer requests for deletion of personal information
controls.what_we_dont_prove: That deletion was technically complete across all systems (the chain attests the workflow; physical deletion is the business's act). Whether an exemption was correctly claimed is a legal determination.
controls.what_we_prove: Right-to-delete requests and the business's response (deletion confirmation, exemption claim, denial) submitted to the chain are stored with tamper-evident ordering and signed timestamps. When the business also submits service-provider deletion confirmations, those are preserved alongside with the same integrity guarantees.

controls.title: Right to Correct — consumer requests for correction of inaccurate personal information
controls.what_we_dont_prove: That the underlying personal information was actually corrected in primary storage, or that the business's determination of inaccuracy was sound.
controls.what_we_prove: Right-to-correct requests and the business's correction or denial response submitted to the chain are stored with tamper-evident ordering and signed timestamps.

controls_out_of_scope.reason: general duties at the point of collection (notice) are document-level
right to know about sale or sharing — overlaps with §1798.110 above; sale-specific opt-out is workflow-level
right to opt-out of sale or sharing is configuration- and process-level
right to limit use and disclosure of sensitive PI is policy- and config-level
notice, disclosure, correction, and deletion mechanisms are UX and policy
methods for limiting sale, sharing, and use of PI are UX
personal information security breach — breach handling is procedural
